m: वेणी—संहार m. ‘binding up of the braided hair’, N. of a well-known drama by Bhaṭṭa-nārāyaṇa (who probably lived in the 9th century; its subject is taken from an incident narrated in the 2nd and 8th books of the Mahā-bhārata, in which is described how Yudhiṣṭhira gambled away all his possessions, including Draupadī, and how Duḥ-śāsana then insulted Draupadī by loosening her braided hair and dragging her away by her dishevelled locks, and how Bhīma, who witnessed the insult, swore that he would one day kill Duḥ-śāsana and drink his blood; this threat he fulfilled, and Draupadī's hair was then bound up again; cf. MBh. ii, 2229-2235, viii, 4235).

a: वेणः — 1 A musician by caste; cf. Ms. 10. 19; वेणानां भांडवादनं 10. 49. --2 N. of a king, son of Aṅga and said to be a descendant of Manu Svāyambhuva. [When he became king, he issued a proclamation prohibiting all worship and sacrifices. The sages strongly remonstrated with him, but when he turned a deaf ear to their words, they killed him with ‘blades of consecrated Kuśa grass.’ The kingdom was now without a ruler. So they rubbed the thigh of the dead body, until a Niṣāda came forth, short in stature and with a flat face. They then rubbed the right arm, and from it sprang the majestic Pṛthu (see Pṛthu). According to the Padma Purāṇa, Veṇa began his reign well, but subsequently fell into Jaina heresy. He is also said to have caused confusion of castes; cf. Ms. 7. 41, 9. 66-67.].

m: वेदाङ्ग See below.

वेदाङ्ग n. ‘a limb (for preserving the body) of the Veda’, N. of certain works or classes of works regarded as auxiliary to and even in some sense as part of the Veda, (six are usually enumerated [and mostly written in the Sūtra or aphoristic style]; 1. शिक्षा, ‘the science of proper articulation and pronunciation’, comprising the knowledge of letters, accents, quantity, the use of the organs of pronunciation, and phonetics generally, but especially the laws of euphony peculiar to the Veda [many short treatises and a chapter of the Taittirīya-āraṇyaka are regarded as the representatives of this subject; but other works on Vedic phonetics may be included under it See प्रातिशाख्य] : 2. छन्दस्, ‘metre’ [represented by a treatise ascribed to Piṅgala-nāga, which, however, treats of Prākṛt as well as Sanskṛt metres, and includes only a few of the leading Vedic metres] : 3. व्याकरण, ‘linguistic analysis or grammar’ [represented by Pāṇini's celebrated Sūtras] : 4. निरुक्त, ‘explanation of difficult Vedic words’ [cf. यास्क] : 5. ज्योतिष, ‘astronomy’, or rather the Vedic calendar [represented by a small tract, the object of which is to fix the most auspicious days for sacrifices] : 6. कल्प, ‘ceremonial’, represented by a large number of Sūtra works [cf. सूत्र] : the first and second of these Vedāṅgas are said to be intended to secure the correct reading or recitation of the Veda, the third and fourth the understanding of it, and the fifth and sixth its proper employment at sacrifices: the Vedāṅgas are alluded to by Manu, who calls them, in iii, 184, Pravacanas, ‘expositions’, a term which is said to be also applied to the Brāhmaṇas), IW. 145 &c.

वेदान्त m. end of the Veda (= ‘complete knowledge of the Veda’, cf. वेदान्त-ग), TĀr.; MBh.

N. of the second and most important part of the Mīmāṃsā or third of the three great divisions of Hindū philosophy (called Vedānta either as teaching the ultimate scope of the Veda or simply as explained in the Upaniṣads which come at the end of the Veda; this system, although belonging to the Mīmāṃsā [q.v.] and sometimes called Uttara-mīmāṃsā, ‘examination of the later portion or ज्ञान-काण्ड [q.v.] of the Veda’, is really the one sole orthodox exponent of the pantheistic creed of the Hindūs of the present day — a creed which underlies all the polytheism and multiform mythology of the people; its chief doctrine [as expounded by Śaṃkara] is that of Advaita i.e. that nothing really exists but the One Self or Soul of the Universe called Brahman [neut.] or Paramātman, and that the Jīvātman or individual human soul and indeed all the phenomena of nature are really identical with the Paramātman, and that their existence is only the result of Ajñāna [otherwise called Avidyā] or an assumed ignorance on the part of that one universal Soul which is described as both Creator and Creation; Actor and Act; Existence, Knowledge and Joy, and as devoid of the three qualities [see गुण]; the liberation of the human soul, its deliverance from transmigrations, and re-union with the Paramātman, with which it is really identified, is only to be effected by a removal of that ignorance through a proper understanding of the Vedānta; this system is also called Brahma-mīmāṃsā and Śārīrakamīmāṃsā, ‘inquiring into Spirit or embodied Spirit’; the founder of the school is said to have been Vyāsa, also called Bādarāyaṇa, and its most eminent teacher was Śaṃkarācārya), Up.; MBh. &c.

m: 1. वेद m. (fr. √ 1. विद्, q.v.) knowledge, true or sacred knowledge or lore, knowledge of ritual, RV.; AitBr.

N. of certain celebrated works which constitute the basis of the first period of the Hindū religion (these works were primarily three, viz. 1. the Ṛg-veda, 2. the Yajur-veda [of which there are, however, two divisions See तैत्तिरीय-संहिता, वाजसनेयि-संहिता], 3. the Sāma-veda ; these three works are sometimes called collectively त्रयी, ‘the triple Vidyā’ or ‘threefold knowledge’, but the Ṛg-veda is really the only original work of the three, and much the most ancient [the oldest of its hymns being assigned by some who rely on certain astronomical calculations to a period between 4000 and 2500 B.C., before the settlement of the Āryans in India; and by others who adopt a different reckoning to a period between 1400 and 1000 B.C., when the Āryans had settled down in the Panjāb]; subsequently a fourth Veda was added, called the Atharva-veda, which was probably not completely accepted till after Manu, as his law-book often speaks of the three Vedas-calling them त्रयम् ब्रह्म सनातनम्, ‘the triple eternal Veda’, but only once [xi, 33] mentions the revelation made to Atharvan and Aṅgiras, without, however, calling it by the later name of Atharva-veda; each of the four Vedas has two distinct parts, viz. 1. Mantra, i.e. words of prayer and adoration often addressed either to fire or to some form of the sun or to some form of the air, sky, wind &c., and praying for health, wealth, long life, cattle, offspring, victory, and even forgiveness of sins, and 2. Brāhmaṇa, consisting of Vidhi and Artha-vāda, i.e. directions for the detail of the ceremonies at which the Mantras were to be used and explanations of the legends &c. connected with the Mantras [see ब्राह्मण, विधि], both these portions being termed श्रुति, revelation orally communicated by the Deity, and heard but not composed or written down by men [cf. IW. 24 &c.], although it is certain that both Mantras and Brāhmaṇas were compositions spread over a considerable period, much of the latter being comparatively modern; as the Vedas are properly three, so the Mantras are properly of three forms, 1. Ṛc, which are verses of praise in metre, and intended for loud recitation; 2. Yajus, which are in prose, and intended for recitation in a lower tone at sacrifices; 3. Sāman, which are in metre, and intended for chanting at the Soma or Moon-plant ceremonies, the Mantras of the fourth or Atharva-veda having no special name; but it must be borne in mind that the Yajur and Sāma-veda hymns, especially the latter, besides their own Mantras, borrow largely from the Ṛg-veda; the Yajur-veda and Sāma-veda being in fact not so much collections of prayers and hymns as special prayer- and hymn-books intended as manuals for the Adhvaryu and Udgātṛ priests respectively [see यजुर्-वेद, साम-वेद]; the Atharva-veda, on the other hand, is, like the Ṛg-veda, a real collection of original hymns mixed up with incantations, borrowing little from the Ṛg and having no direct relation to sacrifices, but supposed by mere recitation to produce long life, to cure diseases, to effect the ruin of enemies &c.; each of the four Vedas seems to have passed through numerous Śākhās or schools, giving rise to various recensions of the text, though the Ṛg-veda is only preserved in the Śākala recension, while a second recension, that of the Bhāṣkalas, is only known by name; a tradition makes Vyāsa the compiler and arranger of the Vedas in their present form: they each have an Index or Anukramaṇī [q.v.], the principal work of this kind being the general Index or Sarvānukramaṇī [q.v.]; out of the Brāhmaṇa portion of the Veda grew two other departments of Vedic literature, sometimes included under the general name Veda, viz. the strings of aphoristic rules, called Sūtras [q.v.], and the mystical treatises on the nature of God and the relation of soul and matter, called Upaniṣad [q.v.], which were appended to the Āraṇyakas [q.v.], and became the real Veda of thinking Hindūs, leading to the Darśanas or systems of philosophy; in the later literature the name of ‘fifth Veda’ is accorded to the Itihāsas or legendary epic poems and to the Purāṇas, and certain secondary Vedas or Upa-vedas [q.v.] are enumerated; the Vedāṅgas or works serving as limbs [for preserving the integrity] of the Veda are explained under वेदाङ्ग below: the only other works included under the head of Veda being the Pariśiṣṭas, which supply rules for the ritual omitted in the Sūtras; in the Bṛhad-āraṇyaka Upaniṣad the Vedas are represented as the breathings of Brahmā, while in some of the Purāṇas the four Vedas are said to have issued out of the four mouths of the four-faced Brahmā and in the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa the Veda and Viṣṇu are identified), RTL. 7 &c.; IW. 5; 24 &c.

3. वेद m. (perhaps connected with √ 1. वे, to weave or bind together) a tuft or bunch of strong grass (Kuśa or Muñja) made into a broom (and used for sweeping, making up the sacrificial fire &c., in rites), AV. MS. Br.; ŚrS.; Mn.

a: वेदः — [विद्-अच् घञ् वा] 1 Knowledge. --2 Sacred knowledge, holy learning, the scriptures of the Hindus. (Originally there were only three Vedas: ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद and सामवेद, which are collectively called त्रयी ‘the sacred triad’; but a fourth, the अथर्ववेद, was subsequently added to them. Each of the Vedas has two distinct parts, the Mantra or Saṃhitā and Brāhmaṇa. According to the strict orthodox faith of the Hindus the Vedas are a-paurusheya, ‘not human compositions’, being supposed to have been directly revealed by the Supreme Being Brahman, and are called ‘Śruti’ i. e. ‘what is heard or revealed’, as distinguished from ‘Smṛti’, i. e. ‘what is remembered or is the work of human origin’; see श्रुति, स्मृति also; and the several sages, to whom the hymns of the Vedas are ascribed, are, therefore, called द्रष्टारः ‘seers’, and not कर्तारः or स्रष्टारः ‘composers’). --3 A bundle of Kuśa grass; Ms. 4. 36. --4 N. of Viṣṇu. --5 A part of a sacrifice (यज्ञांग). --6 Exposition, comment, gloss. --7 A metre. --8 Acquisition, gain, wealth (Ved.). --Comp. --अग्रणीः N. of Sarasvatī. --अंगं ‘a member of the Veda’, N. of certain classes of works regarded as auxiliary to the Vedas and designed to aid in the correct pronunciation and interpretation of the text and the right employment of the Mantras in ceremonials; (the Vedāṅgas are six in number: --शिक्षा कल्यो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छंदसां चयः . ज्योतिषामयनं चैव वेदांगानि षडेव तु ..; i. e. {1} शिक्षा ‘the science of proper articulation and pronunciation’; {2} छंदस् ‘the science of prosody’; {3} व्याकरण ‘grammar’; {4} निरुक्त ‘etymological explanation of difficult Vedic words’; {5} ज्योतिष ‘astronomy’, and {6} कल्प ‘ritual or ceremonial’). --अधिगमः, --अध्ययनं holy study, study of the Vedas. --अधिपः {1} one who presides over the Veda; ऋग्वेदाधिपतिर्जीवो यजुर्वेदाधिपो भृगुः . सामवेदाधिपो भौमः शशिजोऽथर्ववेदपः ... {2} N. of Viṣṇu. --अध्यापकः a teacher of the Vedas, a holy preceptor. --अंतः {1} ‘the end of the Veda’, an Upanishad (which comes at the end of the Veda). {2} the last of the six principal Darśanas or systems of Hindu philosophy; (so called because it teaches the ultimate aim and scope of the Veda, or because it is based on the Upaniṣads which come at the end of the Veda); (this system of philosophy is sometimes called उत्तरमीमांसा being regarded as a sequel to Jaimini's पूर्वमीमांसा, but it is practically quite a distinct system; see मीमांसा. It represents the popular pantheistic creed of the Hindus, regarding, as it does, the whole world as synthetically derived from one eternal principle, the Brahman or Supreme Spirit; see ब्रह्मन् also). ˚गः, ˚ज्ञः a follower of the Vedānta philosophy. --अंतिन् m. a follower of the Vedānta philosophy. --अभ्यासः {1} the study of the Vedas. {2} the repetition of the sacred syllable om. --अर्थः the meaning of the Vedas. --अवतारः revelation of the Vedas. --आदि n., --आदिवर्णः, --आदिबीजं the sacred syllable om. --उक्त a. scriptural, taught in the Vedas. --उदयः N. of the sun (the SāmaVeda being said to have proceeded from him). --उदित a. scriptural, ordained by the Vedas. --कौलेयकः an epithet of Śiva. --गर्भः {1} an epithet of Brahman. {2} a Brāhmaṇa versed in the Vedas. {3} N. of Viṣṇu. --ज्ञः a Brāhmaṇa versed in the Vedas. --त्रयं, --त्रयी the three Vedas collectively. --दृष्ट a. sanctioned by the Vedas --निंदकः {1} an atheist, a heretic, an unbeliever (one who rejects the divine origin and character of the Vedas). {2} a Jaina or Buddhist. --निंदा unbelief, heresy. --पारगः a Brāhmaṇa skilled in the Vedas. --मातृ f. N. of a very sacred Vedic verse called Gāyatrī q. v. --वचनं, --वाक्यं a Vedic text. --वदनं grammar. --वासः a Brāhmaṇa. --वाह्य a. contrary to, or not founded on, the Veda. --विद् m. {1} a Brāhmaṇa versed in the Vedas. {2} N. of Viṣṇu. --विहित a. enjoined by the Vedas. --व्यासः an epithet of Vyāsa who is regarded as the ‘arranger’ of the Vedas in their present form; see व्यास. --संन्यासः giving up the ritual of the Vedas. --संमत, --संमित a. sanctioned by the Vedas.

m: 1. वेदि m. a wise man, teacher, Paṇḍit, L.
वेदि f. knowledge, science (see अ-व्˚)
a seal-ring (also ˚दिका), L.
2. वेदि in comp. for 1. वेदिन्.

3. वेदि f. (later also वेदी; for 1. 2. See col. 2) an elevated (or according to some excavated) piece of ground serving for a sacrificial altar (generally strewed with Kuśa grass, and having receptacles for the sacrificial fire; it is more or less raised and of various shapes, but usually narrow in the middle, on which account the female waist is often compared to it), RV. &c. &c.
the space between the supposed spokes of a wheel-shaped altar, Śulbas.
a kind of covered verandah or balcony in a courtyard (shaped like a Vedi and prepared for weddings &c. = वितर्दि), Kāv.; Kathās.
a stand, basis, pedestal, bench, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
N. of a Tīrtha, MBh. (only ई)
वेदि n. a species of plant (= अम्बष्ठ),
a: वेदिः — [विद्-इन्] A learned man, sage, Paṇḍita. --दिः, -दी f. 1 An altar especially one prepared for a sacrifice; अमी वेदिं परितः कॢप्तधिष्ण्याः (वह्रयः) Ś. 4. 7. --2 An altar of a particular shape, the middle points of which come very close to each other; मध्येन सा वेदिविलग्नमध्या Ku. 1. 39; (some propose to take वेदि in this passage as meaning ‘a sealring’). --3 A quadrangular spot in the court-yard of a temple or palace. --4 A seal-ring. --5 N. of Sarasvatī. --6 A tract or region. --Comp. --ईशः {1} N. of Agni. {2} of Brahman. --जा an epithet of Draupadi who was born from the midst of the sacrificial altar of king Drupada.

k.v: वेदिः परिष्कृता भुमिः समे स्थण्डिलचत्वरे। चषालो यूपकटकः कुम्बा सुगहना वृतिः॥

वेदि—श्रोणि or वेदि—श्रोणी, f. (met.) the hip-like side of the Vedi, ŚrS.

m: वेदि—जा f. ‘altar-born’, epithet of Draupadī, wife of the Pāṇḍu princes (the fee which Droṇa required for instructing the Pāṇḍu princes was that they should conquer Drupada, king of Pañcāla, who had insulted him; they therefore took him prisoner, and he, burning with resentment, undertook a sacrifice to procure a son who might avenge his defeat; two children were then born to him from the midst of the altar, out of the sacrificial fire, viz. a son Dhṛṣṭa-dyumna, and a daughter Draupadī or Kṛṣṇā, afterwards wife of the Pāṇḍavas), L.

a: वेदितृ — a. 1 Knowing. --2 Wise, learned.

m: 1. वेदि—त्व n. acquaintance or familiarity with (see करुण- and कारुण्य-व्˚, and cf. under 3. वेदि).
2. वेदि—त्व n. (for 1. See under 2. वेदि) the state or condition of being a Vedi or altar, MaitrS.
वेदि—वत् ind. like a Vedi, MW.
वेदि—विमान n. = -मान, ŚBr.
वेदिष्ठ mfn. getting or procuring most, RV. viii, 2, 24.
वेदि—षद् (for -सद्), mfn. sitting on or at the V˚, VS.; TBr.
वेदि—षद् m. = प्राचीन-बर्हिस्, BhP.

s: puM, (vedaH vizayajYAnamudaye yasya .) sUryyaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
m: वेदोदय m. ‘origin of the V˚’, N. of Sūrya or the Sun (from whom the Sāma-veda is said to have proceeded; cf. Mn. i, 23), L.

s: tri, (vede uditaH .) vedoktaH । yaTA, -- “vedoditAnAM nityAnAM karmmaRAM samatikrame । snAtakavratalope ca prAyaScittamaBojanam ॥” iti malamAsatattvam ॥
m: वेदोदित mfn. mentioned or enjoined in the V˚, Mn. iv, 14 &c.

s: tri, (vede uktaH .) SrutikaTitaH । yaTA, “vedoktameva kurvvARo niHsaNgo'rpitumISvare । nEzkarmyAM laBate sidDiM rocanArTA PalaSrutiH ॥” iti malamAsatattvam ॥
m: वेदोक्त mfn. taught or declared or contained in the V˚, Mn.; R.
वेदोक्त—शिव-पूजन n. N. of wk.
वेदोपबृंहण See ˚पग्रहण.
वेदोपग्रहण n. an addition or supplement to the V˚, R. (B. ˚पबृंहण).
वेदोपकरण n. ‘Veda-instrument’, a subordinate science for aiding or promoting a knowledge of the Veda (= वेदाङ्ग), Madhus.
वेदोपकरण—समूह m. N. of wk.
वेदोपनिषद् f. the Upaniṣad or secret doctrine of the V˚, TUp.
वेदोपस्थानिका f. attendance on the Veda, Hariv.
वेदोपयाम m. a partic. implement, MānŚr.
वेदुक mfn. acquiring, obtaining, TS.; TBr.
वेद्य् in comp. for 3. वेदि.
वेद्य् See √ वेट्य्, p. 1014, col. 1.
वेद्या f. knowledge, RV.
(accord. to some also, ‘art, dexterity &c.’).
वेद्य्—आकृति f. a kind of V˚, MānGṛ.
वेद्य्—आस्तरण n. covering the V˚ with Darbha grass, L. (cf. वेद-स्त्˚).

s: tri, (vid + Ryat .) veditavyam । yaTA, -- “DarmmaH projJitakEtavo'tra paramo nirmatsarARAM satAm vedyaM vAstavamatra vastu SivadaM tApatrayonmUlanam । SrImadBAgavate mahAmunikfte kiMvA parErISvaraH sadyo hfdyavaruDyate'tra kftiBiH SuSrUzuBistatkzaRAt ॥” iti SrIBAgavate 1 skanDe 1 aDyAyaH ॥ (DanAya hitam । yaTA, fgvede । 2 । 2 । 3 । “raTamiva vedyaM SukraSocizamagnim .” “vedyaM vedo Danam । tasmE hitam .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥ stutyam । taTA, tatrEva । 5 । 15 । 1 । “praveDase kavaye vedyAya giram .” “vedyAya stutyAya .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥ labDavyam । yaTA, vAjasaneyasaMhitAyAm । 18 । 11 । “vittaM ca me vedyaYca me .” “vedyaM labDavyam .” iti tadBAzye mahIGaraH ॥ vedAya hitamiti । veda + yat । bedahitam । vedapratipAdyam । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 158 । 36 । “vedyaYca yat vedayate ca vedyaM viDiSca yaScASrayate viDeyam । Darmme ca vede ca bale ca sarvvaM carAcaraM keSavaM tvaM pratIhi ॥”)
m: 1. वेद्य mfn. notorious, famous, celebrated, RV.; AV.
to be learnt or known or understood, that which is learnt, ŚvetUp.; MBh. &c.
to be recognized or regarded as, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
relating to the Veda, MBh. (cf. g. गव्-आदि).
2. वेद्य mfn. to be (or being) acquired, TS.; VS.
to be married (see अ-व्˚).
a: वेद्य — a. 1 To be known. --2 To be taught or explained. --3 To be married.

m: वेद्य्—अग्नि m. the fire on the Vedi, Vait.
वेद्य्—अन्त m. the end or edge of the V˚, ŚBr.; Lāṭy.
वेद्य्—अन्तर n. the interior of the V˚, KātyŚr.
वेद्य्—अर्ध m. ‘half of a V˚’, N. of two mythical districts held by the Vidyādharas (on the Himālaya, one to the north, and one to the south), Kathās.
वेद्य—त्व n. knowableness, intelligibility, Śaṃk.
वेद्यया ind. instr. sg. (= nom.) and pl. ‘with kn˚’ i.e. manifestly, actually, indeed, ib.
वेद्य्—उपोषण mfn. burning the Vedi, ĀpŚr., Sch.
वेगाघात m. = वेगविधारण, W.
वेगानिल m. a violent wind, Vikr.
वेगावतरण n. swift descent, Śak.

s: [n] tri, (vego'syAstIti । vega + iniH .) vegavAn । tatparyyAyaH । jaNGAkArikaH 2 jANGikaH 3 tarasvI 4 tvaritaH 5 prajavI 6 javanaH 7 javaH 8 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, harivaMSe BavizyaparvvaRi । 20 । 14 । “aSvASca veginaH santi raTA vAyujavA mama ॥”) SyenapakzI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

puM, (vija + GaY .) pravAhaH । tatparyyAyaH । oGaH 2 veRI 3 DArA 4 । iti hemacandraH ॥ javaH । tatparyyATaH । raMhaH 2 taraH 3 rayaH 4 syadaH 5 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, manO । 5 । 108 । “mfttoyEH SuDyate SoDyaM nadI vegena SuDyati ॥”) mahAkAlaPalam । iti medinI ॥ retaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ mUtravizWAdinirgamapravfttiH । iti BarataH ॥ saMskAraviSezaH । yaTA, -- “sparSAdayo'zwO vegAKyasaMskAro maruto guRAH । azwO sparSAdayo rUpaM dravo vegaSca tejasi ॥ sparSAdayo'zwO vegaSca dravatvaYca gurutvakam । rUpaM rasastaTA sneho vAriRyete caturddaSa ॥” iti BAzAparicCedaH ॥ * ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 8 । 25 । “tato'BipadyAByahananmahAsuro ruzA nfsiMhaM gadayoruvegayA ॥”) vegaDAraRanizeDo yaTA, -- “vegaroDo na karttavyaScAnyatra kroDavegataH ॥” iti AhnikatattvaDftavizRuDarmmottaravacanam ॥ api ca । “svaBAvataH pravfttAnAM malAdInAM jijIvizuH । na vegAnvArayedDIraH kAmAdInAYca DArayet ॥” iti rAjavallaBaH ॥
v: pu॰ vija--GaY । 1 pravAhe hemaca॰ । 2 jave amaraH 3 mahAkAlaPale medi॰ 4 retasi hemaca॰ । 5 mUtravizWAdiniH sAraRayatne 6 nyAyokte saMskAraBede ca “sparSAdayo'zwO vegAKyaH saMskAro maruto guRAH” । “kzitirjalaM taTA tejaH pavano mana eva ca । parAparatvamUrtatvakriyAvegASrayA amI” BAzA॰ tasya kzityAdiguRatoktA । “svaBAvataH pravfttAnAM malAdInAM jijIvizuH । na vegaM DArayedDIraH kAmAdInAYca DArayet” rAjani॰ ।
m: वेग m. (fr. √ विज्) violent agitation, shock, jerk, AV.; R.
a stream, flood, current (of water, tears &c.), AV.; ŚvetUp.; MBh. &c.
rush, dash, impetus, momentum, onset, MBh.; BhP.
impetuosity, vehemence, haste, speed, rapidity, quickness, velocity (वेगाद् वेगं-√ गम्, to go from speed to speed, increase one's speed), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the flight (of an arrow), Kir.
outbreak, outburst (of passion), excitement, agitation, emotion, ib.
attack, paroxysm (of a disease), Suśr.
circulation, working, effect (of poison; in Suśr. seven stages or symptoms are mentioned), Yājñ.; Kāv. &c.
expulsion of the feces, Suśr.
semen virile, L.
impetus, Kaṇ.; Sarvad.
the fruit of Trichosanthes Palmata, L.
N. of a class of evil demons, Hariv.
a: वेगः — [विज्-घञ्] 1 Impulse, impetus. --2 Speed, velocity, rapidity. --3 Agitation. --4 Impetuosity, violence, force. --5 A stream, current; as in अंबुवेगः. --6 Energy, activity, determination. --7 Power, strength; मदनज्वरस्य वेगात् K. --8 Circulation, working, effect (as of poison); U. 2. 26, V. 5. 18. --9 Haste, rashness, sudden impulse; Pt. 1. 109. --10 The flight of an arrow; Ki. 13. 24. --11 Love, passion. --12 The external manifestation of an internal emotion. --13 Delight, pleasure. --14 Evacuation of the feces. --15 Semen virile. --16 Pleasure, delight. --Comp. --अनिलः {1} blast caused by speed; V. 1. 4. {2} a strong or violent wind. --आघातः {1} sudden arresting of velocity, check of speed. {2} obstruction of excretion, constipation. --नाशनः the phlegmatic humour. --रोधः = ˚आघातः q. v. --वाहिन् a. swift. --विधारणं checking of speed. --सरः a mule.

k.v: पतङ्गौ पक्षिसूर्यौ च पूगः क्रमुकवृन्दयोः। पशवोऽपि मृगा वेगः प्रवाहजवयोरपि॥
पतङ्गौ पक्षिसूर्यौ च पूगः क्रमुकवृन्दयोः। पशवोऽपि मृगा वेगः प्रवाहजवयोरपि॥

m: वेग—घ्न mfn. killing swiftly, MBh.
वेग—दण्ड m. (= वेतण्ड) an elephant, Hcar.
वेग—दर्शिन् m. N. of a monkey, R.
वेग—ग mf(आ)n. going or streaming fast, Hariv.
वेग—जवा f. N. of a Kiṃ-narī, Kāraṇḍ.

s: puM, (vegasya nASanaM yena .) SlezmA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: वेग—नाशन m. ‘preventing speed or activity’, phlegm, the phlegmatic humour, L.
वेग—नाश्य-नाशक-भावार्थ-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
वेग—परिक्षय m. cessation of the paroxysm of a disease, Suśr.
वेग—राज m. N. of an author
वेग—राज—संहिता f. N. of his wk. (composed A.D. 1494).
वेग—रोध m. obstruction of speed or activity, retardation, check, W.
obstruction of the movement or evacuation of the bowels, ib.
वेग—सार m. pl. N. of a people, VP.
वेग—सम्पन्न mfn. endowed with swiftness, swift (said of horses), R.
वेग—सरी (ई), f. a female mule, Kathās.

s: puM, (vegena sarati gacCatIti । sf + ac .) vegagAmihayaH । tatparyyAyaH । vesaraH 2 aSvataraH 3 । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: puMstrI॰ vegena sarati sf--wa । vegagAmihaye 1 aSvatare hemaca॰ । striyAM NIz । 2 vegagAmimAtre tri॰ striyAM NIp ।
m: वेग—सर m. (cf. वेसर) a mule, L.
वेग—तर m. greater swiftness (वेगाद् वेगतरं-√ गम्, to run faster and faster; cf. वेग), Pañcat. (B.)
वेग—तस् ind. with a sudden impetus, R.
with speed, quickly, hastily, impetuously, Kathās.
वेग—वाहिन् mfn. going or flowing or flying swiftly, R.; Rājat.
वेग—वाहिनी (इनी), f. an arrow, MBh.; MārkP.
वेग—वत् mfn. agitated (as the ocean), R.
impetuous, rapid, hasty, swift, violent, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वेग—वत् m. a leopard, L.
N. of an Asura, MBh.
of a Vidyādhara, Kathās.
of a son of Kṛṣṇa, BhP.
of a king (son of Bandhu-mat), ib.
of a monkey, R.
वेग—वती f. N. of a river, R.
a partic. drug, Suśr.
a kind of metre, Piṅg.
N. of a Vidyādharī, Kathās.
(pl.) N. of a class of Apsarasas or celestial nymphs, VP.
वेग—वत्—स्तोत्र n. N. of a Stotra.
वेग—वत्—ता f. swiftness, velocity, ib.
वेग—वत्—तम mfn. speediest, quickest, very quick or swift, MW.
वेग—वत्—तर mfn. more speedy, quicker, very quick, ib.
वेग—वृष्टि f. a violent rain, L.
वेग—विधारण n. retardation of velocity, stopping, retarding, W.
obstruction of the natural excretions, constipation, Suśr.
वेग—विरोधिन् mfn. obstructing the movement or evacuation of the bowels, ŚārṅgS.
वेगि in comp. for वेगिन्.

s: puM, (vegI vegavAn hariRaH .) SrIkArI mfgaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: वेगि—हरिण m. a kind of antelope, L.
वेगिल m. N. of a man, Kathās.

v: pu॰ vega + astyarTe ini । 1 Syenavihage rAjani॰ । 2 vegavati tri॰ amaraH striyAM NIp ।
m: वेगिन् mfn. having velocity, swift, rapid, impetuous, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वेगिन् m. a hawk, falcon, L.
an express, courier, W.
N. of Vāyu, L.
a: वेगिन् — a. (नी f.) Swift, fleet, impetuous, violent, rapid. --m. 1 A courier. --2 A hawk. --नी A river.

k.v: जङ्घालोऽतिजवस्तुल्यौ जङ्घाकरिकजाङ्घिकौ। तरस्वी त्वरितो वेगी प्रजवी जवनो जवः॥

m: वेगिनी f. a river, MW.
वेगि—ता f. impetus, velocity, quickness, speed, W.

s: tri, (vegaH saYjAto'sya । tArakAditvAditac .) vegaviSizwaH । yaTA, AyurvvedIye । “na vegito'nyasidDiH syAt nAjitvA sADyamAmayam ॥” ityAhnikatattvam ॥
m: वेगित mfn. agitated, rough (as the sea), MBh.
impetuous, hasty, rapid, swift, fleet, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: वेगित — a. Quickened, expedited, hastened.

m: वेगि—त्व n. impetus, velocity, quickness, speed, W.
वेगोदग्र mfn. having rapid or intense effect (as venom), Vikr.
वेह् (also written बेह्) cl. 1. Ā. वेहते, to strive, make effort, Dhātup. xvi, 42; cl. 1. P. वेहति = वेहाय, Vop.
a: वेह् — {c1c} A. (वेहते) See वेह्.

m: वेहानस (with Jainas) a partic. forbidden mode of suicide, Śīl.

s: puM, svanAmaKyAtadeSaH । yaTA, -- “vehAre cEva SrIhawwe koSale SavakarRike । azwAdaSaBujA kAryyA mAhendre ca himAlaye ॥” iti matsyasUkte 50 pawalaH ॥
v: pu॰ vi + hf--GaY pfzo॰ । svanAmaKyAte deSaBede
m: वेहार m. (cf. विहार) N. of a country (Behār), L.
a: वेहारः — N. of a country(Behār).

m: वेहाय Nom. (fr. prec.) Ā. ˚यते, to miscarry g. भृशादि.

s: f Na yatne । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰Atma॰-aka॰-sew .) f, avivehat । Na, vehate । vivehe । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: yatne BvA॰ Atma॰ aka॰ sew caNi na hrasvaH । vehate avehizwa ।

s: strI, (viSezeRa hanti garBamiti । vi + hana + “saMScattfpadvehat .” uRA॰ 2 । 85 । iti atipratyayena nipAtanAt sADuH .) garBopaGAtinI gOH । ityamaraH ॥ anftO vfzopagamanAdivaSAt yasyA garBapAto Bavati sA । vihanti garBaM SaSvat vehat । hana lO gatO vaDe kvip nipAtaH । iti BarataH ॥ (yaTA, vAjasaneyasaMhitAyAm । 18 । 27 । “vaSA ca me fzaBaSca me vehaccame'naqvAMSca me ॥”)
v: strI vi + hana ati nalApaH । garBopaGAtinyAM striyAm amaraH । jAtmA samAse parani॰ । govehat si॰ kO॰
m: वेहत् f. a barren cow or and cow that miscarries, VS.; AV.; Br. (cf. Uṇ. ii, 85; accord. to L. also ‘a cow that desires the bull’ or ‘a pregnant cow’).
a: वेहत् — f. A barren cow.

k.v: वशा वन्ध्यावतोका तु स्रवद्गर्भाथ सन्धिनी। आक्रान्ता वृषभेणाथ वेहद्गर्भोपघातिनी॥

m: वेह्ल् cl. 1. P. वेह्लति v.l. for √ वेल्ल्, Dhātup. xv, 33.
a: वेह्ल् — {c1c} P. (वेह्लते) To go, move.

s: f cAle । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰para॰-saka॰-sew .) f, avivehvat । fdanubanDaH vedezUccAraRaBedArTaH । cAlaH saYcalanaM gatAvityeke । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: gatO BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । vehlati avehlIt caNi na hrasvaH

s: strI, (vija + ac । tamAnayatIti । A + nI + qaH । gOrAditvAt NIz .) somarAjI । iti SabdacandrikA ॥
v: strI vija--ac tamAnayati A--nI--qa gOrA॰ NIz somarAjyAm Sabdaca॰ ।
m: वेजानी f. Vernonia Anthelmintica, L.
वेजन-वत् mfn. (fr. Caus. of √ विज्) used to explain वाजिन्, Nir.
वेजित mfn. (fr. id.) agitated, frightened, terrified, Hariv.; Ragh.
enhanced, increased, MBh.

s: puM, vEkawikaH । matsyaBedaH । BewkI iti BAzA । yuvA । iti medinI ॥ vidUzakaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ tatra pavargIyabakArAdO liKitaH ॥
m: वेकट m. (cf. वैकटिक, only, L.) a youth
a jeweller
a sort of fish
a buffoon (= विदूषक)
वेकट ind. = अद्भुत (cf. 2. वि-कट).
a: वेकटः — 1 A buffoon. --2 A jeweller. --3 A youth.

m: वेकुरि See बेकुरि.
वेक्ष् (prob. for अवेक्ष्, q.v.) cl. 10. P. वेक्षयति, to see, Dhātup. xxxv, 84, b (v.l. व्लेक्ष्).
वेक्षण n. looking after, care about (gen.), Mn. ix, 11 (v.l. for चेक्षणे).
1. वेल् (v.l. for वेल्ल्, q.v.) cl. 1. P. वेलति, to move, shake, Dhātup. xv, 33.
2. वेल् (rather Nom. fr. वेला below) cl. 10. P. वेलयति, to count or declare the time, Dhātup. xxxv, 28. (Cf. उद्-वेल &c.)
a: वेल् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (वेलति) 1 To go, move. --2 To be wanton. --3 To shake, move about, tremble. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (वेलयति-ते) To count the time.

meal-time, meal (as of a god = ईश्वरस्य भोजनम्, Śiva's meal), L.

‘sickness’ or ‘passion’ (राग or रोग), L.
the gums, L.
speech, L.
N. of the wife of Buddha, L.
of a princess found on the seashore (after whom the 11th Lambaka of the Kathāsarit-sāgara is called).
a: वेला — 1 Time; वेलोपलक्षणार्थमादिष्टोस्मि Ś {4} --2 Season, opportunity. --3 Interval of repose, leisure. --4 Tide, flow, current. --5 The seacoast, sea-shore; वलोनिलाय प्रमृता भुजंगाः R. 13. 12, 15; स वेलावप्रवलयां (उर्वी) 1. 30, 8. 80, 17. 37; Śi. 3. 79; 9. 38. --6 Limit, boundary. --7 Speech. --8 Sickness. --9 Easy death. --10 The gums. --11 Passion, feeling. --Comp. --कूलं N. of a district called Tāmralipta. --मूलं the sea-shore. --वनं a wood on the sea-coast.

of a Rājarṣi or royal Ṛṣi (father of Pṛthu, and said to have perished through irreligious conduct and want of submissiveness to the Brāhmans; he is represented as having occasioned confusion of castes See Mn. vii, 41; ix, 66; 67, and as founder of the race of Niṣādas and Dhīvaras; according to the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa, Vena was a son of Aṅga and a descendant of the first Manu; a Vena Rāja-śravas is enumerated among the Veda-vyāsas or arrangers of the Veda), MBh.; Hariv.; Pur.
v.l. for वेण, q.v.
a: वेन — See वेण (2).

s: strI, (vana Sabde saMBaktO vA + “vanericcopaDAyAH .” uRA॰ 3 । 8 । iti naH upaDAyA itvaYca .) nadIviSezaH । iti sidDAntakOmudyAmuRAdivfttiH । (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 88 । 3 । “vennA BImaraTI coBe nadyO pApaBayApahe ॥”)
v: strI vana--na upaDAyA icca । nadIBede “vinadIM piYjalAM vennAM(RAm)tuNgavennAM(RAM) mahAnadIm” BA॰ BI॰ 9 a॰ ।
m: वेन्ना f. (cf. वेणा and वेण्वा) N. of a river, Uṇ. iii, 8, Sch.
a: वेन्ना — See वेणा.

m: वेन्य mfn. to be loved or adored, lovable, desirable, RV.
वेन्य m. N. of a man, ib.
वेप् See √ 1. विप्, p. 972, col. 3.
a: वेप् — {c1c} A. (वेपते, वेपित) To tremble, shake, quiver, quake; कृतांजलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी Bg. 11. 35; R. 11. 65.

v: kampane BvA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ sew । vezate avepizwa । fdit caNi na hrasvaH । zwvit । vepaTuH ।
m: वेप mf(ई)n. vibrating (voice), RV. vi, 22, 5
वेप m. = next, Kauś.; BhP.

s: puM, (vepanamiti । vepa + “wvito'Tuc .” 3 । 3 । 89 । iti aTuc .) kampaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, gItAyAm । 1 । 29 । “vepaTuSca SarIre me romaharzaSca jAyate ॥”)
m: वेपथु m. quivering, trembling, tremor, AV. &c. &c.
वेपथु mfn. trembling, quaking, VarBṛS.
a: वेपथुः — [वेप्-अथुच्] Tremor, trembling, heaving (of breasts &c.); अद्यापि स्तनवेपथुं जनयति श्वासः प्रमाणाधिकः Ś. 1. 30, 24; Śi. 9. 22; 73; R. 19. 23; Ku. 4. 17, 5. 85.

k.v: स्वरूपं च स्वभावश्च निसर्गश्चाथ वेपथुः। कम्पोऽथ क्षण उद्धर्षो मह उद्धव उत्सवः॥

m: वेपथु—भृत् mfn. possessing tremor, trembling, Śiś.
वेपथु—मत् mfn. possessed of tremor, trembling, Śak.
वेपथु—परीत mfn. possessed of tremor, trembling, R.; Suśr.

s: klI, (vepa + lyuw .) kaspanam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, suSrute SArIrasTAne 10 ADyAyaH । “tatra vidDasya kroSanavinamanamohanaBramaRavepanAni maraRaM vA Bavati ॥”)
m: वेपन mfn. trembling, quivering, fluttering, TS.; ŚBr.; VarBṛS.; Suśr.
वेपन n. quivering, trembling, tremor, Gobh.; R. &c.
shaking, brandishing, R.
a: वेपनं — [वेप्-ल्युट्] Tremor, trembling.

वेपस् n. quivering, quaking, struggling, RV.
stirring, agitation, ib.
= अनवद्य, L.
वेपित n. trembling, agitation (in स-वेपितम्), Śāntiś.
वेपिष्ठ mfn. (superl. of विप्र, q.v.) most inspired, RV.

m: वेडा f. (also written बेडा) a boat, L. (cf. वेटी).
a: वेडा — A boat.

m: वेड n. a kind of coarse sandal (= सान्द्र-विच्छिन्न-चन्दन), L.
a: वेडं — A kind of sandal.

saffron
the mouth.

a: वेरकः — Camphor.

वेरट n. the fruit of the jujube, L.
a: वेरटः — A low man, one belonging to an inferior caste. --टं The fruit of the jujube.

a: वेस् — {c1c} P. (वेसति) To go, move.

वेसरी f. a female mule, Divyāv.

m: वेसर m. (cf. वेग-सर; also written वेशर) a mule, VarBṛS.; Śiś.

a: वेसरः — A mule; Śi. 12. 19.

s: puM, DanyAkasarzapAdipizwaH । vesAra iti vAwanA iti ca KyAtaH । tatparyyAyaH । upaskaraH 2 । ityamaraH । vezavAraH 3 । iti BarataH ॥ veSavAraH 4 । iti mukuwaH ॥ (yaTA, suSrute । 1 । 46 । “mudgAdivesavArARAM pUrRA vizwamBino matAH । vesavArEH sapiSitEH sampUrRA guruvfMhaRAH ॥”) vyaYjanaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “nirasTi piSitaM pizwaM sidDaM guqaGftAnvitam । kfzRAmaricasaMyuktaM vesavAra iti smftam ॥” asya guRAH । “vesavAro guruH snigDo balopacayavardDanaH ॥” iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ hiNgvArdrakamarIcajIrakaharidrADanyAkAH krameRa dbiguRaparimARenEkatrIkftAH । iti pAkarAjeSvare pAkapariBAzA ॥

m: वेसवार m. (also written वेशव्˚, or वेषव्˚) a partic. condiment or kind of seasoning (consisting of ground coriander, mustard, pepper, ginger, spice &c.), Suśr.
a: वेस(श)वारः — A particular condiment (consisting of ground coriander, mustard, pepper, ginger &c.).

m: वेता f. = वेतन, L.
वेताला f. a form of Durgā, Vās.
वेतालाख्यायिका f. N. of wk.
वेतालासन n. a kind of posture (in which the right hand holds the toe of the left foot, and the left hand holds the toe of the right foot), L.
वेताली f. N. of Durgā, Hariv.

s: puM, dvArapAlakaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ BUtADizWitaSavaH । ityamaraH ॥ mallaBedaH । iti BarataH ॥ SivagaRADipaviSezaH । yaTA, -- sagara uvAca । “ko'sO BEravanAmABUt ko vA vetAlasaMjYakaH । kaTaM vA tO SarIreRa mAnuzeRa gaRADipO । aBUtAM dvijaSArddUla tanme vada mahAmune ॥ SrIOrvva uvAca । SfRu rAjan pravakzyAmi mahAkAlasya BfNgiRaH । BEravasyApi caritaM vetAlasya mahAtmanaH ॥ so'sO BfNgI harasutO mahAkAlo'pi BargajaH । tAveva gOrISApena saMBUya narayonijO । vetAlaBEravO jAtO pfTivyAM nfpaveSmani ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 45 aDyAyaH ॥ tasyotpattyAdi yaTA, -- SrIdevyuvAca । “mamEva mAnuzI mUrttiriyaM vfzaBaketana ! । viSAmi te'tra vacanAdutpAdaya sutadvayam ॥ praviveSa tato devI svayaM tArAvatItanO । mahAdevo'pi tasyAstu kAmArTaM samupasTitaH ॥ tataH sAparRayAvizwA devI tArAvatI satI । kAmayAnaM mahAdevaM svayamevABavanmudA ॥ tasmin kAle'BavadgarBaH kApAlI cAsTimAlyaDfk । kAmAvasAne tasyAstu sadyo jAtaM sutadvayam ॥ aBavannfpaSArdUla taTA SAKAmfgAnanam । aTa tArAvatI devI sutO dfzwvA kzitisTitO ॥ BUmO malinaveSena manyunA samupArviSat । BartturAgamanaM SaSvat kANkzantI BargaBAzitam ॥ aTa kzaRAnmahABAgaH sa rAjA candraSeKaraH । prAsAdapfzWe AgacCaddrazwuM tArAvatIM tadA ॥ dadarSa patitAM BUmO muktakeSIM nirutsavAm । sutO ca patitO BUmO candrasUryyasamapraBO ॥ vAnarAsyO sa dadfSe padakzoBaM vfzasya ca । tataH sa rAjA nyagadat taM muniM prahasanmudA ॥ pAlayizye SamBusutO yaTA laByaM sadEva hi । kintvetO muniSArdUla tvaM saMskuru yaTAviDi ॥ Orvva uvAca । tatastayornAma cakre nArado vacanAnnfpa । jyezWo BEravanAmABUt vIraH puttro BayaNkaraH ॥ vetAlasadfSaH kfzRo vetAlo'BUttaTAparaH । iti cakre tayornAma devarzirbrahmaRaH sutaH ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 49 aDyAyaH ॥
v: pu॰ aja--vic vIBAvaH tala--GaY karma॰ । 1 mallaviSeze 2 BUtADizWitaSavaBede amaraH 3 SivAnucare BEravaBede kAlikApu॰ । 4 dvArapAle ca Sabdara॰ ।
m: वेताल m. (of doubtful derivation) a kind of demon, ghost, spirit, goblin, vampire (esp. one occupying a dead body), Hariv.; Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
N. of one of Śiva's attendants, KālikāP.
of a teacher, BhP.
of a poet, Cat.
a door-keeper (?), L.
a: वेतालः — 1 A kind of ghost, a goblin, vampire; particularly a ghost occupying a dead body; नाहमात्मनाशाय वेतालोत्थापनं करिष्यामि ‘I shall not raise a devil for my own destruction’; Māl. 5. 23, Śi. 20. 60. --2 A doorkeeper.

s: puM, rAjavikramAdityasya navaratnAntargataratnaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “DanvantariH kzapaRakAmarasiMhaSaNkuvetAlaBawwaGawakarparakAlidAsAH । KyAto varAhamihiro nfpateH saBAyAM ratnAni vE vararucirnava vikramasya ॥” iti navaratnaSlokaH ॥
m: वेताल—भट्ट m. N. of a poet (the author of the Nīti-pradīpa, and one of the 9 men of letters said to have flourished at the court of Vikramāditya; cf. नव-रत्न), Cat.
वेताल—जननी f. N. of one of the Mātṛs attendant on Skanda, MBh.
वेताल—कर्म-ज्ञ mfn. knowing the doings of a Vetāla, VarBṛS.
वेताल—कवच n. N. of a Kavaca (q.v.), Cat.

वेताल—पञ्च-विंशति or वेताल—पञ्च-विंश˚तिका, f. a collection of 25 tales or fables told by a Vetāla or demon to king Vikramāditya (of which there are 5 recensions extant, one by Kṣemendra in his Bṛhat-kathā-mañjarī, one by Soma-deva in the Kathā-sarit-sāgara, and the other three by Jambhala-datta, Vallabha, and Śiva-dāsa ; versions of these popular tales exist in Hindī, Tamil and Telugu, and almost every Hindū vernacular).
वेताल—पुर n. N. of a town, Siṃhās.
वेताल—रस m. a partic. mixture, L.
वेताल—साधन n. winning or securing (the favour of) a Vetāla, Kathās.
वेताल—सिद्धि f. the supernatural power of a Vetāla, Buddh.
वेताल—स्तोत्र n. N. of a Stotra.
वेताल—विंशति f. N. of a collection of 20 Vetāla tales by Veṅkaṭa-bhaṭṭa.
वेतालोत्थापन n. the act of raising a Vetāla, Mālatīm.
वेत m. (prob. corrupted fr. वेत्र; but See Uṇ. iii, 118) a cane, reed, L.
a: वेतः — A cane, reed.
वेतं(दं)डः — An elephant; Bv. 1. 62.

m: वेतण्डा f. a form of Durgā, Vās. (v.l. for वेताला).
वेतण्ड m. (cf. वितण्ड, वेदण्ड, वेग-दण्ड) an elephant, Hcar.; Kād.; Bhām.
वेतनादान n. non-payment of wages, Mn. viii, 218.

v: na॰ 6 ta॰ । vyavahAraBede yatsvarUpAdikaM vIrami॰ uktaM yaTA nAradaH “BftAnAM vetanasyokto dAnAdAnaviDikramaH । vetanasyAnapAkarma tadvivAdapadaM smftam” । yetanaM karmamUlyaM tasyAnapAkarma BftyAya samarpaRaM samarpitasya vA parAvarttanan । tatra samarpaRe viSezamAha sa eva “BftyAya vetanaM dadyAt karmastvAmI yaTAkramam । AdO maDye'vasAne tu kamaRo yadviniScitam” । tuByametAvadahaM dAsyAmIti yadvetanaM parimARato niScitaM tattriDA viBajya karmaRa AdimaDyAntezu trizu kAlezvanyatamakAle vA dadyAdityarTaH । etaccEtAvadvetanaM dAsyAmIti BAzAyAH sattve । asattve tvAha sa eva “BftAvaniScitAyAM tu daSaBAgamavApnuyuH । lABaM govIryyaSasyAnAM vaRiggopakfzIbalAH” iti । daSaBAgaM daSamamBAgaNgovIryyaM pAlyamAnagavAdiBavampayodaDyAdi । yadi karmasvAmI BftyAya daSamamBAganna prayacCati tadA'sO rAjYA dApya ityAha yAjYavalkyaH “dApyastu daSamamBAgaM vARijyapaSuSasyataH । aniScitya BftiM yastu kArayet sa mahIkzitA” iti । yastu syAmI vetanaparicCedamakftvEva BftyaM karma kArayati sa tasmAd vARijyapaSuSasyalakzaRAt karmaRaH sakASAd yallabDaM tasya daSamaM BAgaM BftyAya mahIkzitA rAjYA dApanIya ityarTaH । yat tu “triBAgaM paYcaBAgaM vA gfhRIyAt sIravAhakaH” iti vfhaspativacanaM tadbahvAyAsasADyAkfzwakzetravizayam । vyavasTitavikalpaScAyam । kaTamatra vyavasTetyAkANkzAyAmAha sa eva “BaktAcCAdaBftaH sIrI BAgaM gfhRIta paYcamam । jAtaSasyAttriBAgaM tu pragfhRIyAdaTA'BftaH” iti । aSanAcCAdanAByAM BftaH kfzIyalo lANgalavikfzwakzetrajAtaSasyAt paYcamamBAgaM gfhRIyAt । tAByAmaBftastu tftIyaM BAgamityarTaH । aTa vA yatrEtAvaddAsyAmIti nAsti pariBAzA tatra vfdDamanUktaM drazwavyam “samudrayAnakuSalA deSakAlArTadarSinaH । niyacCeyurBftiM yAntu sA syAt prAgakftA tadA” iti । etAvaddAsyAmIti pariBAzite'pi kvacittato nyUnamapi svAmimAtraparikalpitaM deyaM kacittato'Dikamapi deyamitTAha yAjYavalkyaH “deSaM kAlaYca yo'tIyAllABaM kuryyAcca yo'nyaTA । tatra syAt svAminaSCando'DikaM deyaM kfte'Dike” iti । yo BftyaH svAmyanujYAM vinA svAtantryeRa vARijyAdikarmaRaH PalasADakatvApAdakaM deSaM kAlaM cAtikrAmati lABaM vA bahutaraM vyastena svalpaM karoti tasmE pUrvapariBAzitaBftimaDye svAmI svecCAnusAreRa kiYcid dadyAt । yastu svAtantryeRa bahulABaM karoti tasmE pariBAzitamUlyAdaDikaM kiYciddeyaM svAminA pAritozikamityarTaH । anekaBftyasADyakarmaRi vetanArpaRaprakAramAha sa eva “yo yAvat kurute karma tAvat tasya tu vetanam । uBayorapyasADyaM cet sADye kuryyAd yaTASrutam” iti । uBayorapItyapinA bahUnAM grahaRam asmin gfhAdO kfte BavatAmetAvadvAsyAmIti parimAzite dvibahuBirArabDaM karma yadi vyADyAdivaSAnna samApitaM tadA tezu yo yAvat karma karoti tasmE tatkarmAnusAreRa maDyasTaparikalpitaM vetanaM deyam । na tu sAmyena dAnanna ca parisamAptyaBAvAdadAnam । yadi tEH samApitaM tadA yaTA pariBASitaM deyanna tu pratyekaM kftsnaM dAtavyaM nApi karmAnusAreRa parikalpya dAtavyamityarTaH । yastu vetanaM gfhItvA samarTo'pi na karma karoti taM pratyAha vfhaspatiH “gfhItavetanaH karma na karoti yadA BftaH । samarTaSceddamandApyo dviguRaM tacca vetanam” iti । damaM SaktyanusAreRa rAjYA dApyaH । gfhItaYca vetanaM dvEguRyena svAmine dadyAdityarTaH । nArado'pi “BftiM gfhItvA'kurvARo dviguRAM BftimAvahed” iti । yAjYavalkyo'pi “gfhItavetanaH karmatyajan dviguRamAvahed” iti । asminneva vizaye yAvatA vetanena BftyatvamaNgIkftaM tAvadeva svAmine deyanna tu rAjYe daRqamityarTaH । yadvANgIkftAM BftiM dattvA valAtkArayitavya ityAha nAradaH “karmAkurvan pratiSrutya kAryo dattvA BftiM valAd” iti । pratiSrutyeti prAramBasyApyupalakzaRArTam ataeva kAtyAyanaH “karmAramBaM tu yaH kftvA sidDinnEva tu kArayet । balAtkArayitavyo'sAvakurvan daRqamarhati” iti । kiyad dravyaM daRqya ityapekzAyAmAhaturvfdDa manuvfhaspatI “pratiSrutTa na kuryyAd yaH sa kAryaH syAd balAdapi । sa cenna kuryyAt tatkarma prAptuyAd dviSataM damam” iti । dviSataM kArzApaRadviSatamityarTaH । yat tu manuvacanam “Bfto'nArtto na kuryyAd yo darpAt karma yaToditam । sa daRqyaH kfzRalAnyazwO na deyaM tasya vetanam” iti । tadalpadaRqatvAdBAgAsidDivizayamiti smfticandrikAyAm । ardDvanyUnakarmakaraRavizayamiti madanaratne । kiYcinnyUnakarmakaraRe tvAha sa eva “yaToktamArttaH susTo vA yastatkarma na kArayet । na tasya vetanaM deyamalponasyApi karmaRaH” iti । susTo vA karma kArayediti vadatA susTe'pi svayaM kartftvaniyamo nAstIti darSayati । Artto yadi ArtyupaSamAnantaraM svANgIkftaM karma karoti tadArtte dIrGakAlatayA kAlakzepe'pi BftyadozABAvAdvetanamasO nirvivAdaM saBata ityAha sa eva “Arttastu kuryyAt susTaH san yaTABAzitamAditaH । sudIrGasyApi kAlasya tallametEva vetanam” AditaH AdO yaTAmAzitaM yaTApratijYAtaM taTA kuryyAdityarTaH । sudIrzasyApi kAlasya atyaye'prIti SezaH । yastu kAlaviSezAvaDikaM karma pratijYAya tatkAlApUrttAveva karma tyajati taM pratyAha nAradaH “kAle'pUrRe tyajan karma BftarnASamavApnuyAd” । atra daRqamapyAha vizRuH BftakaScApUrRe kAle tyajan sakalameva mUlyaYjahyAt rAjYe ca paRaSataM dadyAditi” । mUlyaM vetanam । svAmidozAttyAge tu yAvati kAle karma kftaM tatkAlAnusAreRa kalpitaM vetanaM laBata ityAha nAradaH “svAmidozAdapakrAman yAvat kftamavApnuyAd” iti । svAmidozo vinAparADaM nizWuraBAzaRAdiH । atra daRqamapyAha vizRuH “svAmo cadBftakamapUrRe kAle jahyAt tasya sarvameva mUlyaM dadyAt paRyaYca rAjanyatra BftAdAzAditi” । svAmidravyasya BftyadozeRa nASe yat karttavyaM tadAha sa eva । “taddAzeRa yadvinaSyettat svAmine deyamanyatra dEvopaTAtAditi” । dEvopaGAtorAjakftasyApyupalakzaRama । svAmine deyaM mUlyadvAreReti SezaH । atra dozaviSezaH । dviSezamAha vfhanmanuH “prAmAdAnnASitaM dApyaH samaM dvi rdrohanASitam” iti । pramAdAnnASitamanabaDAnanASitaM samameva dadyAt । drohanASitaM tIvraprayatnAdinA droheRa nASitaM dvirdApyo dviguRaM dApya ityaTaH । BftyadozABAve yadanyata eva nazwaM tanna deyamityAha sa eva “na tu dApyo hataYcOrErdagDamUQaM jalena veti” । UQaM nItam । yastu vAhako vAhyaM dravyaM prajYAhInAtvAdinA svadozeRa nASayati taM pratyAha nAradaH “BARqaM vyasanamAgacCedyadi vAhakadozataH । dApyo yattatra naSyettu dEvarAjakftAdfte” iti । BARqaM vahanIyaM dravyaM saktukAdi vyasanaM nASam । atra BARqavAhakayorgraharRabalIvardakfzIbalayorupalakzaRamiti madanaratne । atrApi “pramAdAnnASitaM dApyaH samaM dvirdrohanASitamiti” vfdDamanUktoviSezo'vagantavyaH । yastu vAhakaH svadozaRa prasTAnaviGnaM karoti sa dviguRAM Bfti dApya ityAha kAtyAyanaH “viGna yo vAhako dApyaH prasTAne dviguRAM Bftim” iti । viGnaM karotIti SezaH । vAhakagrahaRaM pradarSanArTaM na tu vivAkzatantenAyuDIyAderyudDaviGnakAriRI'pyetaditi mantavyam । ataeva nAradaH “dviguRAM tu BftiM dApyaH prasTAne viGnamAcaran” iti sAmAnyenoktavAn । yAjYavalkyo'pi “prasTAnaviGnakfccEva padApyo dviguRAM Bftim” iti । etacca BftyAntarasampAdanakAlAsamBavavizayam । aNgIkftakarmakaraRasyApi yadA sahAyAntarAlABena prasTAnaviGnApAdakatvaM tadA tvAha sa eva “prakAnte saptamammAgaYcaturTaM paTi santyajan । BftimarNGapaTe sarvAM pradApyastyAjako'pi ca” iti । prakrAnte karmaRi svANgIkftaM karma tyajan mftyo BfteH saptamamBAgaM dApyaH । gamane prArabDe paTi tyajan BfteScaturTaM BAgam । ardDvapaTe tyajan sarvAM BftimityarTaH । tyAjako'pi cetyasyAyamarTaH gamanAramBAnantaraM svAmI yadi tyAjayati tadA pUrvoktakrameRa BfyAya saptamaBAgAdikaM dApanIya iti । etaccAvyADitAdivizayam vyADitasyAparADABAvAt । yacca svAminA tyAjane ca turTaBAgadApanamuktaM tadavikrItaBARqasvAmibizayam । vikrAtaBARqasvAminA yat karttavyaM tadAha vfhanmanuH “paTi vikrIya tadBARqaMbaRik BftyaM tyajed yadi । aTa tasyApi deyaM syAd BfterardDvaM kaBeta saH” iti । paTi BARqasya cOrAdiBiH pratiroDe rAjAdiBirapahfte svAminaH karttavyamAha kAtyAyanaH “yadA ca paTi yadBARqamArudDyeta hriyeta vA । yAvAnaDvA gatastena prApnuyAt tAvato Danam” iti । tena BAravAhakasvIkftena yAnAdinA । BARqanetAraM pratyAha nAradaH “anayanBAwayitvA tu BARqayan yAnavAhanam । dApyo BfticaturBAgaM sarvAmardDvapaTe tyajan” iti । yAnaM SakawAdi vAhanam aSvAdi । ayamarTaH yo yAnAdinA BARqanayanaM kartuM parakIyaM yAnAdikaM BAwayitvA prApaRAdikAryopADikaM parikrayaM kftvA tanna nayati sa yAnasvAmine parikalpitasya BAwakasya caturTA'MSaM dApyaH । yastu tannItvA'rdDamArge tyajati sa sarvAM BftiM dApya iti । yastu SakawAdikaM BAwayitvA tamevopakAraSUnyamAdAya deSAntaraM gacCati BAwakaM ca na prayacCati taM GnatyAha vfdDamanuH “yo BAwayitvA SakawaM nItvA vA'nyatra gacCati । BAwaM ma dadyAd dApyaH syAdanUQasyApi BAwakam” iti । anUQasyApi akftopakArasyApItyarTaH । yastu kfte kftye samanantaraM vAhanAdeH samarpaRaM na karoti tasya samarpaRaparyyantaBAwakadAnamAha kAtyAyanaH “hastryaSvagoKarozwrAdIn gfhItvA BAwakena maH । nArpayet kftakftyaH saMstAvaddApyaH sa BAwakam । gfha vAryApaRAdIni gfhItvA BAwakena yaH । svAmine nArpayed yAvattAvaddApyaH sa BAwakam” iti । vAriSabdena tadADAraBUtaM pAtraM lakzyate । nArpayet kftakftyaH sannityanuzaNgaH । paraBUmO gfhanirmARAya BAwakadAtAraM pratyAha nAradaH “paraBUmO gfhaM kftvA stomaM dattvA vaset tu yaH । sa tadgfhItvA nirgacCet tfRakAzWezwakAdikam” iti । stomamBAwakaM stomApradAne'pyAha sa eva “stomAdvinA vasitvA tu paraBUmAvaniScitam । nirgacCaMstfRakAzWAni na gfhRIyAt kaTaYcana । yAnyeva tfRakAzWAni tvizwakA viniveSitAH । vinirgacCaMstu tat sarvaM BUmiKAmini yedayed” iti । svAmine nivedayedityarTaH । aniScitamiti vadatA tfRakAzWAdigrahaRAgrahaRapariBAzAvihInavizayametaditi darSitam । pariBAzAvizaye tu yaTA pariBAzitaM karttavyam । BAwake gfhItAnAM jalapAtrAdInAM BaNge nASe ca viSezamAha sa eva “stomavAhIni BARqAni pUrRakAlAnyupAnayet । gfhIturAharedBagnaM nazwaYcAnyatra saMplavAt” iti । stomavAhIni BAwakagfhItAni pUrvapariBAzitaBAwakAni tatsvAminaM prApayediti pUrvArdDArTaH । BagnamekadeSena vikftaM nazwam kAtsnyena vikftam । saMplavaH parasparasaNGarzaH tadBinnaprakAreRa yadBagnannazwaYca tadBAwakagfhIturBavati । saMplavena tu yadBagnannazwaYca tadBAwakadAtrA pUrvavat kftvA mUlyadvAreRa vA deyamityarTaH । vyADitasya Bftyasya svAminA paTi tyAge daRqamAha kAtyAyanaH “tyajet paTi sahAyaM yaH SrAntaM rogArttameva vA । prApnuyAt sAhasaM pUrvaM grAme tryahamapAlayan” iti । svAmyanujYAtena BftyenAparADe kfte so'parADaH svAmina evetyAha vfhaspatiH “praBuRA viniyuktaH man Bftako vidaDAti yat । tadarTamaSuBaM karma svAmI tatrAparADnuyAd” iti । svAmI kftakarmaRe BftakAya yadi na vetanaM dadAti tadA'sO rAjYA dApanIyaH ityAha sa eva “kfte karmaRi yaH svAmI na dadyAdvetanaM Bfte । rAjYA dApayitavyaH syAd vetanaYcAnurUpataH” iti । veSyAtadupaBoktfvizaye nArada Aha “SulkaM gfhItvA paRyastrI necCantI dviguRaM vahet । anicCan SulkadAtApi SulkahAnimavApnuyAt” iti । etadavyADitAdivizayam । vyADitAdivizaye tvAha vfha॰ spatiH “vyADitA saSramavyaTA rAjakAryaparAyaRA । ABantritA ca nAgacCedavAcyA baqavA smftA” iti । AmantritA AhUtA । vaqavA dAsI tadgrahaRamatra paRyastrIpradarSanArTam । upaBoktAraM pratyAha nAradaH “aprayacCannaTo SulkamanuBUya pumAn striyam । akrameRa tu saNgacCeda GAtadantanaKAdiBiH । ayonO yaH samAkrAmed bahuBirvApi vAsayet । SulkaM so'zwaguRaM dAzyo vinayaM tAvadeva tu” iti । veSyAyAstvaparADe daRqAdikaM matsyapurARe darSitam “gfhItvA vetanaM veSyA loBAdanyatra gacCati । tAM damaM dApayeddadyAditarasyApi BAwakam” iti । itarasya dattaSulkasya । tatrEva viSezAntara muktam “anyamudiSya veSyAM yo nayedanyasya kAraRAt । tasya daRqo BavedrAjYaH suvarRasya ca mAzakam । nItvA Boganna yo dadyAd dApyo dviguRavetanam । rAjYaSca dviguRaM daRqaM taTA Darmo na hIyate । bahUnAM vrajatAmekAM sarve tad dviguRaM Danam । tasyE dadyuH pfTak rAjYe daRqaYca dviguRamparam” iti । atra nirRetFnAha nAradaH “veSyAHpraDAnA yAstatra kAmukAstadgfhozitAH । tatsamutTezu kAryyezu nirRayaM saMSaye viduH” iti ।

s: puM, (vetranAmako'suraH .) svanAmaKyAtAsuraH । tasyotpattiryaTA, -- mahAtapA uvAca । “AsIdrAjA purA rAjan sinDudvIpaH pratApavAn । vAruRAMSo mahArAjo'sO'raRye tapasi sTitaH ॥ puttro me SatrunASAya Bavediti narADipaH । evaM kftamatiH so'Ta mahatA tapasA svakam । kalevaraM sTiro BUtvA SozayAmAsa suvrataH ॥ prajApAla uvAca । kaTaM tasya dvijaSrezWa SakreRApakftaM Bavet । yenAsO tadvinASAya puttramicCan vrate sTitaH ॥ mahAtapA uvAca । so'nyajanmani puttro'BUt tvazwurbalavatAM varaH । avaDyaH sarvvaSastrOGErapAM Penena nASitaH ॥ jalaPenena nihitastasmillayamavApnuyAt । puRarbrahmAnvayo jAtaH sinDudbIpetisaMjYitaH ॥ sa tepe paramaM tIvraM SakravEramanusmaran । tataH kAlena mahatA nadI vetravatI SuBA ॥ mAnuzaM rUpamAsTAya sAlaNkArA manoramam । AjagAma yato rAjA tepe paramakaM tapaH ॥ tAM dfzwvA rUpasampannAM sa rAjA krudDamAnasaH । uvAca kAsi suSroRi satyaM kaTaya BAmini ॥ nadyuvAca । ahaM jalapateH patnI varuRasya mahAtmanaH । nAmnA vetravatI puRyA tvAmicCantIha AgatA ॥ sABilAzAM parastrIM yo BajamAnAM visarjjayet । sa pApapuruzo jYeyo brahmahatyAYca vindati ॥ evaM jYAtvA mahArAja BajamAnAM Bajasva mAm । evamuktastayA rAjA sABilAzopaBuktavAn ॥ tasya sadyo'Bavat puttro dvAdaSArkasamapraBaH । vetravatyudare jAto nAmnA vetrAsuro'Bavat ॥ balavAnatitejasvI prAgjyotizaH patirBavet । sa kAlena yuvA jAto balavAn dfQavikramaH ॥ mahAyogena saMyukto jigAya ca vasunDarAm । saptadvIpavatIM paScAnmeruparvvatamAruhan । tatrendraM praTamaM jigye paScAdagniM yamaM tataH ॥” iti varAhapurARe devotpattinAmADyAyaH ॥

m: वेत्रीय mfn. (fr. वेत्र) g. उत्करादि.

s: puM, (vI + “guDfvIpacIti .” uRA॰ 4 । 166 । iti traH .) svanAmaKyAtavfkzaH । tatparyyAyaH । vetaH 2 yogidaRqaH 3 sudaRqaH 4 mfduparvvakaH 5 ॥ (yaTA, SAkuntale । 5 । “AcAra ityaDikftena mayA gfhItA yA vetrayazwiravaroDagfhezu rAjYaH ॥”) sa tu paYcaviDaH । tezAM guRAH । SItalatvam । kazAyatvam । BUtapittaharatvaYca । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ tasyAgraM vetAg iti KyAtam । tadguRAH । dIpanatvam । rucyatvam । tiktatvam । pittakaPanASitvaYca । tatPalaguRAH । vAtapittanASitvam । amlatvaYca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ asuraviSezaH । tasya pramARaM vetrAsuraSabde drazwavyam ॥
m: वेत्र m. n. (accord. to Uṇ. iv, 166, fr. √ 1. वी; prob. connected with √ 1. वे cf. वेणु) a kind of large reed (used for making sticks, prob. Calamus Rotang or Fasciculatus), Kauś.; MBh. &c.
वेत्र n. a cane, staff, VarBṛS.; BhP.; MaitrUp., Sch.
the rod or mace of an officer, staff of a door-keeper (see comp.)
the tube of a flute, Saṃgīt.
a: वेत्रः — [अज्-त्रल् वीभावः Uṇ. 4. 166] 1 The cane, ratan. --2 A stick, staff, particularly the staff of a doorkeeper; वामप्रकोष्ठार्पितहेमवेत्रः Ku. 3. 41. --Comp. --आसनं a cane-seat. --धरः, --धारकः {1} a doorkeeper. {2} a mace-bearer, staff-bearer. --यष्टिः f. a staff of reed; Ś. 5. 3.

m: वेत्र—भृत् m. = -धर, Dharmaś.
वेत्र—धारक m. = -धर, L.
वेत्र—धारिन् m. ‘staff-bearer’, the servant of a great man, Pañcad.
वेत्र—धरा f. a female door-keeper, Ragh.

s: puM, (vetrasya DaraH .) dvArapAlaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥ yazwiDArake, tri ॥
v: pu॰ vetraM Darati Df--ac । 1 dvArapAle halA॰ 2 vetrayazwiDAramAtre tri॰ ।
m: वेत्र—धर m. ‘staff-bearer’, a door-keeper, L.
वेत्र—फल n. the fruit of Vetra, Suśr.
वेत्र—दण्डिक m. ‘reed-staff bearer’, a door-keeper, L.
वेत्र—ग्रहण n. ‘grasping the staff’, the office of a door-keeper, Ragh.

s: [n] puM, (vetraM hatavAn । hana + kvip .) indraH । ityamaraH ॥

m: वेत्र—हन् m. N. of Indra, L. (prob. w.r. for वृत्र-हन्).
वेत्र—हस्त m. = -पाणि, Kathās.
वेत्र—कार m. a worker in reed, R.
वेत्र—कीचक-वेणु m. pl. different sorts of reed, BhP.
वेत्रकीया f. a reedy place, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 153, Sch.

s: tri, (vetra + “naqAdInAM kuk ca .” 4 । 2 । 91 । iti kuk CaSca .) vetrasamUhayuktadeSAdiH । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥ (ekacakrA nagarI tu vetraprAcuryyavattvena tadAKyayApi prasidDA । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 161 । 9 । “vetrakIyagfhe rAjA nAyaM nayamihAsTitaH । upAyaM taM na kurute yatnAdapi sa mandaDIH ॥”)
v: tri॰ vetra + Ca--kukca । 1 vetrasamUhe 2 tadyuktadeSAdO ca si॰ kO॰ ।
m: वेत्रकीय mfn. reedy, abounding with reeds or canes, g. नडादि
a: वेत्रकीय — a. Reedy, abounding in reeds.

m: वेत्रकीय—गृह n.
वेत्रकीय—वन n. N. of places, MBh.
वेत्र—करीर m. n. the shoot or fresh sprout of a reed, Suśr.
वेत्र—लता f. ‘reed-branch’, a staff or stick, Pañcat.
वेत्र—लता—चय m. a heap of sticks, R.
वेत्र—लता—मय mf(ई)n. made of sticks, Hcar.
वेत्र—नदी f. N. of a river, Divyāv.
वेत्र—पाणि m. ‘staff-handed’, a mace-bearer, Hariv.
वेत्र—वन-माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
वेत्र—वत् mfn. containing or consisting of reeds, BhP.
वेत्र—वत् m. N. of a mythical being (a son of Pūṣan), Kathās.

s: strI, nadIviSezaH । ityamaraH ॥ sA tu mAlavadeSAt kAlapInAmanagare yamunAyAM militA । vetrAsuramAtA । yaTA, varAhapurARe । “vetravatyudare jAto nAmnA vetrAsuro'Bavat ॥”
v: strI vetrA bAhulyena santyasyAH matup masya vaH vA dIrGaH । 1 mAlavadeSasTe nadIBede “SarAvatI vetravatI candraBAgA sarasvatI” । 2 vfttAsuramAtari varAhapu॰ ।
m: वेत्र—वती f. a female door-keeper, Śak.; Prab.
a form of Durgā, Hariv. (v.l. चित्र-रथी)

N. of a river (now called the Betwā, which, rising among the Vindhya hills in the Bhopāl State and following a north-easterly direction for about 360 miles, falls into the Jumnā below Hamīrpur), MBh.; R. &c.
of the mother of Vetrāsura, VarP.
a: वेत्रवती — 1 A female doorkeeper. --2 N. of a river; Me. 24.

k.v: शोणो हिरण्यवाहः स्यात्कुल्याल्पा कृत्रिमा सरित्. शरावती वेत्रवती चन्द्रभागा सरस्वती॥

m: वेत्र—व्यासक्त-हस्त mfn. one whose hands cling to a reed or reeds, MBh.
वेत्र—यष्टि f. a staff of reed or cane, Śak.
वेत्रिक m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. (v.l. वेणिक).
वेत्रिन् mfn. (ifc.) having a cane, having anything for a cane, MaitrUp.
वेत्रिन् m. a staff-bearer, door-keeper, Rājat.
a: वेत्रिन् — m. 1 A doorkeeper, warder. --2 Staff-bearer.

s: [f] tri, jYAtA । vettIti vidaDAtostfRpratyayena nizpannamidam ॥ (yaTA, hitopadeSe । “yaTA KaraScandanaBAravAhI BArasya vettA natu candanasya ॥”)

v: tri॰ vida--Gfc । 1 jYAtari 2 voQari 3 labDari ca rAjani॰
m: 1. वेत्तृ mfn. (fr. √ 1. विद्) one who knows or feels or witnesses or experiences, a knower, experiencer, witness, ŚvetUp.; MBh. &c.
वेत्तृ m. a sage, one who knows the nature of the soul and God, W.
2. वेत्तृ m. (fr. √ 3. विद्) one who obtains in marriage, an espouser, husband, Āpast.
a: वेत्तृ — m. [विट्-तृच्] 1 A knower --2 A sage. --3 A husband, an espouser. --4 One who obtains.

m: वेत्तृ—त्व n. knowledge, MW.

s: ra kza lu Na kAntigativyAptikzepaprajanaKAdane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-Atma॰-kAntO aka॰-anyatra saka॰-sew .) ra, vEdikaH । kza, avevayuH । bahulaM brahmaRIti parasmEpade anus sidverityan us RurusyaWyAmiti guRaH । lu Na, vevIte । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

m: वेवी (cf. Intens. of √ 1. वी) cl. 2. Ā. वेवीते (3. pl. वेव्यते, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 6, Sch.), to go; to pervade; to conceive; to desire; to throw; to eat, Dhātup. xxiv, 69.
a: वेवी — {c2c} A. (वेवीते) 1 To go. --2 To obtain. --3 To {{concieve->conceive||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}}, be pregnant. --4 To pervade. --5 To cast, throw. --6 To eat. --7 To wish, desire. --8 To shine; (seldom used in classical literature).

m: वेविदत्, वेविदान. See Intens. of √ 3. विद्.
वेविजान See Intens. of √ विज्.
वेविज mf(आ)n. (fr. Intens. of √ विज्) starting, quick, RV.
वेविषत्, वेविषाण. See Intens. of √ विष्.
वेट् ind. an exclamation used in sacrificial, ceremonies, VS.
वेटा f. the abode of the Vaiśya tribe (?), W.
वेटा-वत् mfn. (fr. वेट), Gaṇar.
वेटी f. a boat, L.
वेट m. a kind of tree (= पीलु-वॄक्ष), Gaṇar.
वेटक m. N. of a man, Naigh., Introd.
वेट्—कार m. the exclamation वेट्, ŚBr.
वेट्य् (v.l. वेद्य्) cl. 1. P. वेट्यति, ‘to be wicked’ or ‘to sleep’ (धौर्त्ये स्वप्ने च) g. कण्ड्व्-आदि.
वेय mfn. to be woven &c.
वेय—च्छला f. N. of a ch. of the Sāma-veda-cchalā.
वेय—गान n. a partic. song-book or manual of singing (giving, with the Āraṇya-gāna, the various modifications of intonation for the Ārcika division of the Sāma-veda).
वेषाधिक mfn. very well clothed, too well dressed, VarYogay.
वेषान्य-त्व n. change of dress, VP.

m: वेष m. (ifc. f(आ or ई). cf. भूत-वेषी; fr. √ विष्) work, activity, management, VS.; Kauś.; KātyŚr.

dress, apparel, ornament, artificial exterior, assumed appearance (often also = look, exterior, appearance in general), Mn.; MBh. &c. (acc. with √ कृ or आ-√ स्था, ‘to assume a dress’, with √ गम् or वि-√ धा, ‘to assume an appearance’; with आ-च्छाद्य, ‘concealing one's appearance’, ‘disguising one's self’; प्रच्छन्न-वेषेण id.)
often w.r. for वेश
वेष mfn. working, active, busy, VS. (cf. प्रातर्-व्˚).
a: वेष — See वेश.

k.v: तनूरुहं रोम लोम तद्वृद्धौ श्मश्रु पुम्मुखे। आकल्पवेषौ नेपथ्यं प्रतिकर्म प्रसाधनम्.।

m: वेष—धारिन् mfn. wearing the dress of (comp.), R.
वेष—धारिन् m. a hypocrite, false devotee, L.
वेष—धर mfn. having only the appearance of, disguising one's self, acting a part, Siṃhās.
(ifc.) disguised as, Divyāv.

m: वेषणा (आ), f. id., MānGṛ.
Flacourtia Cataphracta, L.

v: pu॰ viza--karaRe lyuw । 1 kAsamarde (kAlakAsunde) hArA॰ । 2 DanyAkavfkze strI ratnamA॰ ।
m: वेषण or वेषण, n. service, attendance, RV.
a: वेषणं — Occupation, possession.

m: वेष—श्रि or वेष—श्री (वेष-), mfn. beautifully adorned, TS.; ŚBr.
वेष—दान m. the sunflower (= सूर्यशोभा), L.
वेष—कार m. (used to explain वेष्टन), L.
वेषवार incorrect for वेसवार.

k.v: कलम्बश्च कडम्बश्च वेसवार उपस्करः। तिन्तिडीकं च चुक्रं च वृक्षाम्लमथ वेल्लजम्.।

m: वेष—वत् mfn. well-dressed (for सु-व्˚), Kām.
वेषिन् See छद्म-व्˚ and विकृत-वेषिन्.
वेष्क m. (cf. वेष्ट and ब्लेष्क) a noose for strangling a sacrificial victim, ŚBr.

s: puM, (vevezwIti । viza vyAptO + “pAnIviziByaH paH .” uRA॰ 3 । 23 । iti paH .) pAnIyam । ityuRAdikozaH ॥
m: वेष्प m. water, Uṇ. iii, 23, Sch.
a: वेष्पः, वेष्यः — Water.

m: वेष्ट् (cf. विष्ट्) cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. viii, 2) वेष्टते (pf. विवेष्टे fut. वेष्टिता &c. Gr.), to wind or twist round, Sāh.; to adhere or cling to (loc.), AV.; to cast the skin (said of a snake), R.; to dress, MW. : Caus. वेष्टयति, ˚ते (aor. अविवेष्टत्, or अववेष्टत्; Pass. वेष्ट्यते), to wrap up, envelop, enclose, surround, cover, invest, beset, TBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to tie on, wrap round (a turban &c.), MBh.; Rājat.; to cause to shrink up, ŚvetUp. : Desid. विवेष्टिषते Gr.: Intens. वेवेष्ट्यते, वेवेष्टि, ib.
a: {{वेष्->वेष्ट्||20170110||https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,|}} — {c1c} A. (वेष्टते) 1 To surround, enclose, encompass, envelop. --2 To wind or twist round. --3 To dress. --Caus. (वेष्टयति-ते) 1 To surround &c. --2 To blockade. --WITH आ to fold. --परि, --सं to fold together, clasp or wind round.

m: वेष्टावार (?) n. a kind of factitious salt, L. (cf. वेसवार).

pu॰ vezwa--GaY ac vA । 1 vezwane 2 SrIyezwe rAjani॰ 3 vfkzaniryAse ca (AwA) vEdyakam ।
m: वेष्ट m. enclosing, an enclosure, L.
a band, noose, Kauś.; MBh.
a tooth-hole, Suśr.
gum, resin, L.
turpentine, L.
वेष्ट n. (that which surrounds) Brahman or the sky, L.
a: वेष्टः — [वेष्ट्-घञ् अच् वा] 1 Surrounding, enclosing. --2 An enclosure, a fence. --3 A turban. --4 Gum resin, exudation. --5 Turpentine. --Comp. --वंशः a kind of bamboo. --सारः turpentine.

s: klI, (vezwate iti । vezwa + Rvul .) uzRIzaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ niryAsaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ SrIvezwaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

puM, (vezwate iti । vezwa + Rvul .) prAcIraH । yaTA prAcInAvezwakO vftiH । iti hemacandraH ॥ kuzmARqaH । yaTA, -- “kuzmARqakaH puzpaPalo GanavAsaSca vezwakaH ॥” iti hArAvalI ॥ SrIvezwaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ vezwanakArake, tri ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 7 । 136 । 21 । “balayEraparidDESca taTEvANgulivezwakEH ॥”)
v: na॰ vezwa--Rvul । (pAgaqI) 1 uzRIze Sabdara॰ । 2 kuzmARqe rAjani॰ । 3 prAcIre pu॰ hemaca॰ । 4 vezwanakArake tri॰ ।
m: वेष्टक m. See अङ्गुलि-व्˚
a wall, fence, W.
(in gram.) putting a word before and after इति, VPrāt.
Beninkasa Cerifera, L.
वेष्टक m. n. turpentine, L.
वेष्टक n. a head-band, turban, L.
resin, gum, L.
वेष्टक mfn. who or what encompasses or surrounds, W.
a: वेष्टकः — [वेष्ट्-ण्वुल्] 1 An enclosure, a fence. --2 A pumpkin-gourd. --कं 1 A turban. --2 A wrapper, mantle. --3 Gum, exudation. --4 Turpentine.

m: वेष्टनीय mfn. to be surrounded or wound round, Nyāyam.

s: klI, (vezwate iti । vezwa + lyuH .) karRaSaskulI । uzRIzaH । (yaTA, raGuH । 8 । 12 । “tamaraRyasamASrayonmuKaM SirasA vazwanaSoBinA sutaH ॥”) mukuwaH । vftiH । iti medinI ॥ gugguluH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ (vezwa + lyuw । valayanam । yaTA, raGuH । 4 । 48 । “BogivezwanamArgezu candanAnAM samarpitam ॥”)
v: na॰ vezwa--karaRe lyuw । 1 karRaSazkulyAm 2 uzRIze 2 mukuwe ca 4 guggulO Sabdaca॰ । BAve lyuw । 5 vftO medi॰ ।
m: वेष्टन n. the act of surrounding or encompassing or enclosing or encircling (कृत-वेष्टन, ‘surrounded’, ‘beset’; cf. also अङ्गुलि-व्˚), GṛŚrS.; Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
anything that surrounds or wraps &c., a bandage, band, girdle (˚नं-√ कृ, ‘to bandage’), MBh.; Pañcat.
a head-band, tiara, diadem, MBh.; Ragh.; Kathās.
an enclosure, wall, fence, Megh.
a covering, case, MW.
a span, MārkP.
the outer ear (i.e. the meatus auditorius and concha), L.
a kind of weapon, L.
a partic. attitude in dancing (either a disposition of the hands or crossing of the feet), W.
a rope round the sacrificial post, L.
